title: Spring Boot actuator thread dump is exposed
summary: The /actuator/threaddump endpoint returns every thread and its stack, which leaks internal class and method names and sometimes data in flight.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and "json" in header("content-type") and body_contains("threads") and body_contains("stackTrace") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Secure the actuator endpoints in production.
